BOOKKEEPING PROPOSAL

P R O P O S E D  B Y

YOUNG PEOPLE’S THEATRE

6 JAN, 2026

SCOPE & SERVICES

Summary of Engagement
Sympl will provide bookkeeping support to Young People’s Theatre for an initial 3-month engagement (January–March 2026). During this period, our team will follow all existing YPT processes, systems, file structures, and approval workflows exactly as they currently operate, ensuring continuity.
A Sympl bookkeeper will work approx ~4 hours per day, Monday–Thursday, supported by oversight from Sympl’s Operations Manager and Principal.
After March 2026, Sympl can continue providing support and lead a Phase 2 improvement plan, including workflow modernization and migration from Sage 50 to QuickBooks Online, if desired.

1) Payables & Expenditures
Sympl will manage all outgoing financial activity related to vendors, credit cards, and reimbursements, operating fully within YPT’s existing systems (SAGE 50, Telpay, server storage).
Scope
Enter and code vendor invoices in SAGE using YPT’s chart of accounts and coding details supplied by department staff
Prepare AP payment batches for Telpay
Review monthly corporate credit card reconciliations, verifying receipts, HST treatment, and coding, and posting summary entries into SAGE
Maintain accurate digital filing using YPT’s existing folder structure
Flag any irregularities, missing documents or concerns to Finance Director
Cadence
AP invoice entry: Ongoing
Status update meeting: Weekly
Payments: Bi-monthly
Credit card reconciliation: Monthly

2) Receivables & Revenues
Sympl will support timely and accurate recording of all income streams and ensure that bank deposits align with ticketing, donation, and fundraising activity.
Scope
Conduct weekly revenue reconciliation between bank deposits and:
VBO ticket sales
VBO donation transactions, CanadaHelps, United Way etc
Rental or workshop revenue
Maintain AR tracking for school invoices (box office), rental invoices (production) and education/program invoices
Match incoming payments to outstanding AR, maintain an up-to-date aging schedule, and communicate overdue items to relevant teams
Ensure documentation is stored accurately in the server for audit readiness
Cadence
Revenue reconciliation: Weekly
AR updates: Biweekly, or another mutually aligned cadence

3) Onboarding & Setup
Scope
In-person onboarding (1–2 days): Sympl Principal and Operations Manager onsite to review workflows, meet staff, and map out process touchpoints across Finance, Box Office, Development, Production etc.
Shadow outgoing staff to document and review in detail current AP/AR, Telpay, VBO, and credit card procedures.
Set up secure VPN access, SAGE 50 remote connectivity, Telpay permissions, VBO access, and folder structures.
Establish daily communication via email, weekly call, documentation protocols, and escalation processes.

FEES

Bookkeeping Service (Jan–Mar 2026) Monthly Fee
Payables & Expenditures included
Receivables & Revenues included
Total Monthly Fee $4,000 + HST

One-Time Onboarding & Setup Fees
In-Person Onboarding (1–2 days) $900
Systems/Access Setup (VPN, SAGE, Telpay, VBO, drive) $500
Process Documentation & Transition $1,400
Total One-Time Fee $2,800 + HST

Total (Jan - March 2026) $14,800 + HST

WHY US?

Sympl Solutions is committed to ensuring a high standard of financial clarity and timely support. We bring:
A responsive, detail-oriented team
Deep experience working with organizations across the arts, education, and immigration nonprofit sectors in Canada
Streamlined tech integration and clear process flows
Decade-long expertise in nonprofit finance
BIPOC-led leadership with lived experiences in community arts

We value thoughtful system design, clarity in reporting, and building long-term trusted partnerships.

Any new requirements or adjustments can be discussed and integrated as needed. We work with transparency, flexibility, and a commitment to helping our partners thrive.
